svg.title: Crowd thread: Underground comix crosshatch
svg.desc: Crowd thread (2D): a relief-hall queue side-on in dense underground-comix crosshatching on cheap off-white paper. The plague-marked stand packed shoulder to shoulder, lumpy and tired, drawn in heavy pen. Dr. Tox moves left to right through the queue in his shroud; around him a ring of bare white paper is his breath radius, and nobody may stand in it. Where the queue presses close the ring is pinched; a gap ahead is marked with an arrow. A hand-lettered sign over the shutter and a Pulse line along the bottom margin, amber where he waits.
